<!-- wp:html --><style>
/* Hide TT4 theme chrome — our design has its own nav/footer */
.wp-site-blocks > header,
.wp-site-blocks > footer,
header.wp-block-template-part,
footer.wp-block-template-part,
.wp-block-template-part:first-child { display: none !important; }
.wp-block-post-title, .wp-block-spacer { display: none !important; }

/* Force body background to match our design */
html, body, .wp-site-blocks {
  background: #080E1C !important;
  background-color: #080E1C !important;
}

/* Ensure page wrapper is full-width */
#pacerai-homepage {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100vw;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* Remove TT4 content area padding/constraints */
.wp-site-blocks,
.wp-site-blocks > main,
.wp-site-blocks > main > .wp-block-group,
.wp-site-blocks .is-layout-constrained,
.wp-site-blocks .is-layout-constrained > :where(:not(.alignleft):not(.alignright):not(.alignfull)),
.has-global-padding,
.entry-content {
  max-width: none !important;
  padding-left: 0 !important;
  padding-right: 0 !important;
  margin-left: 0 !important;
  margin-right: 0 !important;
  padding-top: 0 !important;
}

  :root {
    --navy: #080E1C;
    --navy-mid: #0F1929;
    --navy-light: #162038;
    --navy-border: #1E2D4A;
    --brand: #1C3560;
    --brand-blue: #2B7DC8;
    --teal: #27899A;
    --teal-light: #70C49C;
    --teal-pale: #D6F0E8;
    --cream: #F7F3EC;
    --white: #FFFFFF;
    --muted: #8A95A8;
    --text-light: #CDD5E0;
    --text-mid: #94A3B8;
    --green: #2DB87A;
    --red-subtle: #C94C4C;
  }

  #pacerai-homepage * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  #pacerai-homepage { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  #pacerai-homepage {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    background: var(--navy);
    color: var(--text-light);
    overflow-x: hidden;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.65;
  }

  /* ─── NAV ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 48px;
    height: 68px;
    background: rgba(8,14,28,0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28,53,96,0.6);
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-logo {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    text-decoration: none;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li { position: relative; }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li > a {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    color: var(--text-mid);
    text-decoration: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li > a:hover { color: var(--white); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li > a .chevron {
    font-size: 10px; margin-top: 1px;
    transition: transform 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li:hover > a .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

  /* Dropdown */
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown {
    display: none;
    position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 20px;
    padding-top: 28px;
    min-width: 520px;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -12px; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 12px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li:hover .dropdown { display: block; }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0 32px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown-col-label {
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal);
    padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 6px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown a {
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px;
    padding: 10px 10px; border-radius: 8px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.15s;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown .d-icon {
    width: 32px; height: 32px; flex-shrink: 0;
    background: var(--navy-light);
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    border-radius: 7px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown .d-text .d-title {
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--white);
    display: block; line-height: 1.3;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown .d-text .d-desc {
    font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.4;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .single-dropdown { min-width: 220px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .single-dropdown a {
    padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px;
    text-decoration: none; display: block;
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-light);
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .single-dropdown a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: var(--white); }

  /* Hamburger */
  #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 8px;
    z-index: 101;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn span {
    display: block;
    width: 22px; height: 2px;
    background: var(--text-light);
    border-radius: 2px;
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn.open span:nth-child(1) {
    transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
  #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn.open span:nth-child(3) {
    transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px);
  }

  #pacerai-homepage .nav-right {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-ghost {
    padding: 8px 18px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-light); background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-radius: 7px;
    cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--white); border-color: rgba(39,137,154,0.45); }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-teal {
    padding: 9px 20px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff; background: var(--teal);
    border: none; border-radius: 7px;
    cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.2s; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-teal:hover { background: var(--teal-light); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(39,137,154,0.35); }

  /* ─── HERO ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .hero {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 160px 24px 80px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .hero-bg {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse 900px 600px at 50% 30%, rgba(39,137,154,0.09) 0%, transparent 70%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse 600px 400px at 80% 60%, rgba(45,184,122,0.04) 0%, transparent 60%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, var(--navy) 0%, #0B1324 100%);
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .hero-bg::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(rgba(39,137,154,0.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(39,137,154,0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 60px 60px;
    mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 40%, black, transparent);
  }

  #pacerai-homepage .hero-eyebrow {
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 16px 6px 8px;
    background: rgba(39,137,154,0.10);
    border: 1px solid rgba(39,137,154,0.22);
    border-radius: 100px;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal);
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease both;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .hero-eyebrow .dot {
    width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--teal);
    animation: pulse 2s infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.8); }
  }

  #pacerai-homepage h1 {
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(42px, 6vw, 72px);
    font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.08;
    color: var(--white);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    max-width: 860px;
    animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.1s ease both;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--teal); }

  #pacerai-homepage .hero-sub {
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    font-size: 17px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-mid);
    max-width: 580px; line-height: 1.7;
    margin: 24px auto 40px;
    animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.2s ease both;
  }

  #pacerai-homepage .hero-ctas {
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
    animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.3s ease both;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-lg {
    padding: 14px 30px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff; background: var(--teal);
    border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    transition: all 0.25s;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(39,137,154,0.30);
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-lg:hover { background: var(--teal-light); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 32px rgba(112,196,156,0.40); }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-outline-lg {
    padding: 13px 28px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--white); background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-outline-lg:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }

  /* ─── SECTION HEADINGS ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .section { padding: 100px 48px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .section-inner { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }

  #pacerai-homepage .section-eyebrow {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal);
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage h2 {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 56px);
    font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--white);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage h2 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--teal); }

  #pacerai-homepage .section-lead {
    font-size: 16px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-mid);
    max-width: 560px; line-height: 1.75; margin-top: 18px;
  }

  /* ─── ARCHITECTURE DIAGRAM ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-section {
    padding: 100px 48px;
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-inner { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-flow {
    display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 0;
    margin-top: 64px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-col {
    flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-col-label {
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-pill {
    padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 10px;
    background: var(--navy-light);
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-light);
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-pill:hover { border-color: rgba(39,137,154,0.35); }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-pill .ap-icon { font-size: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-arrow {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    padding: 0 20px; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-arrow-line {
    width: 48px; height: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--teal), var(--teal-light));
    position: relative;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-arrow-line::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; right: -6px; top: -5px;
    width: 0; height: 0;
    border-left: 8px solid var(--teal-light);
    border-top: 6px solid transparent;
    border-bottom: 6px solid transparent;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-center {
    flex: 1.4;
    background: var(--navy-light);
    border: 1px solid rgba(39,137,154,0.25);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 28px;
    position: relative;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-center::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--brand), var(--brand-blue), var(--teal), var(--teal-light));
    border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-center-label {
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal);
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-steps {
    display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-step {
    flex: 1; padding: 14px 12px; border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    text-align: center;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-step .as-icon { font-size: 20px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-step .as-label {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--white);
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-step .as-desc {
    font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 3px;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .arch-step-arrow {
    color: var(--teal); font-size: 16px; flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* ─── PLATFORM PILLARS ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .pillars-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 1px;
    margin-top: 64px; border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .pillar {
    background: var(--navy-mid); padding: 36px;
    transition: background 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .pillar:hover { background: var(--navy-light); }
  #pacerai-homepage .pillar-icon {
    font-size: 28px; margin-bottom: 20px;
    display: block;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .pillar h4 {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--white);
    margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.2;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .pillar p { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.7; }
  #pacerai-homepage .pillar ul {
    list-style: none; margin-top: 18px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .pillar ul li {
    font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-mid);
    padding: 5px 0;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .pillar ul li::before {
    content: ''; width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--teal); flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* ─── INTEGRATION GRID ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .integ-grid {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 20px;
    margin-top: 48px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .integ-cat {
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 24px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .integ-cat-label {
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal);
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    padding-bottom: 10px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .integ-badge {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 6px 12px; margin: 3px 4px 3px 0;
    border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-light);
    background: var(--navy-light);
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .integ-badge:hover { border-color: rgba(39,137,154,0.35); }

  /* ─── CTA ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .cta-section {
    padding: 100px 48px;
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .cta-inner {
    max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .cta-inner h2 { font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 52px); }
  #pacerai-homepage .cta-inner p { color: var(--text-mid); font-size: 16px; margin: 18px 0 40px; line-height: 1.7; }
  #pacerai-homepage .cta-buttons {
    display: flex; gap: 14px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  /* ─── FOOTER ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage footer {
    background: var(--navy);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    padding: 80px 48px 40px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-top {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 48px;
    padding-bottom: 64px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    margin-bottom: 40px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-brand p {
    font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.7; margin-top: 16px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-col-head {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-light);
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-col ul { list-style: none; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-col ul li { margin-bottom: 10px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-col ul li a {
    font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--teal); }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom .copy {
    font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom .legal {
    display: flex; gap: 24px;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom .legal a {
    font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom .legal a:hover { color: var(--text-mid); }

  /* ─── ANIMATIONS ─── */
  @keyframes fadeUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  /* ═══════════════ MOBILE ═══════════════ */
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    #pacerai-homepage nav {
      padding: 0 16px;
      height: 56px;
      backdrop-filter: none;
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
      background: #080E1C;
      overflow: visible;
    }
    #pacerai-homepage .nav-links {
      display: none !important;
      position: fixed;
      top: 56px; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: #080E1C;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: stretch;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      z-index: 200;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
      list-style: none;
    }
    #pacerai-homepage .nav-links.mobile-open { display: flex !important; }
    #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border); }
    #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li > a {
      padding: 16px 0; font-size: 16px;
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: #CDD5E0;
    }
    #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li > a:hover { background: none; }
    #pacerai-homepage .nav-links .dropdown {
      position: static !important; transform: none !important;
      min-width: 0 !important; background: transparent !important;
      border: none !important; box-shadow: none !important;
      padding: 0 0 12px 16px !important; border-radius: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
    }
